title: Wilfand: The first snow in Russia will fall on the night of September 19
text:
The first temporary snow cover in the Russian Federation will be founded on the sixth night in Yakutia. This was TASS by TASS by the supervisor of the Russian Hydrometeorology Center Roman Wilfand.
He noted that the wet snow was observed in the south of the Far East.
But the situation when snow forms a temporary snow layer, we can say what happened for the first time this year after the winter period, Mr. Vil Vilfand noted.
He added that on Friday and on weekends in Yakutia, Tuyet, Snow Wet and the Wind up to 21 m/s are expected. In Sakhalin, in the Primorsky and Khabarovsk, strong rains, wind and impaired hydrological situation are expected.
Wilfand: In the Moscow region, it is expected to reduce it notably
The day before, the leader of Meteonovosti Tatyana Pozdnyakova said that she did not believe that the prediction of snow could occur in Moscow in September.
At the same time, experts have warned of reducing the expected night temperature after starting the astronomy in September 23 to 2 thermal level 7 ° C. The expert noted that because the negative temperature is not expected, there will be no snow.
Earlier, the Russians were warned of unusual weather.
